user_reported_bug: Renforcer complètement la partie Administration pour la gestion des utilisateurs (compte admin uniquement): créer, modifier, désactiver, réinitialiser mot de passe, gérer infos, attribuer rôle et groupes. Formulaire multi-sections (Compte, RH, Planning, Paie, Documents, Accès). Chaque utilisateur créé doit pouvoir se connecter avec le mot de passe généré.
summary: Focused verification of admin user-management. No relevant testing skill found. Backend CRUD/auth flows passed end-to-end, and UI creation/login/actions mostly work, but the full user-visible flow is not fixed because immediate table refresh/search after UI create failed, Copier raises a clipboard permission error, non-admin route shows the wrong restriction text, and reset password uses a modal instead of the requested toast.

minor.issue: Created user response had email:null when only personal_email was provided; code uses setdefault so None is not replaced by personal_email, despite the expected response including email.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking Copier triggered browser console page error: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied. The copy flow was not proven functional.
Employee is blocked from /management/utilisateurs, but visible text is 'Accès réservé aux administrateurs' instead of required 'Accès restreint' from UserManager.
Reset password action displays TempPasswordModal ('Mot de passe réinitialisé') rather than the requested toast containing the new password.

integration_issues.flow: Create user via UI then close TempPasswordModal
integration_issues.issue: Immediately after closing the temp-password modal, searching the created personal email showed 'Aucun utilisateur ne correspond aux filtres' / 0 affiché, even though stats increased and the user was later found after admin re-login. This violates the required immediate table refresh/user appears outcome.

action_items: Fix UserManager immediate refresh/state sync after create so the new user is visible/searchable without re-login/reload.
Make Copier robust in the temp-password modal (handle clipboard permissions/fallback) and verify it actually copies.
Show the expected 'Accès restreint' message for non-admin users at /management/utilisateurs, or route employee requests into UserManager's restriction state.
Align reset-password quick action with the required UX (toast with new password) or update the spec if the modal is intended.
Populate email/phone fields from personal_email/personal_phone when professional values are omitted.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth and DB remain MOCKED: localStorage + X-Employee-Id and in-memory/idempotent seed style data, not production-grade auth.
In admin_create_user, data.setdefault('email', ...) and data.setdefault('phone', ...) do not replace Pydantic-provided None values; use explicit fallback assignment.
The requested Documents section/tab is not present in UserEditor; implementation has 5 tabs (Compte/RH/Planning/Paie/Accès) per merged MVP note, but original bug text mentions Documents.
seed_data_creation: Created one API test user and one UI test user; both were deleted during test cleanup/quick-action delete. No residual qa/test.ui users found afterward.

rca_of_the_issue: Frontend state/render issues remain around the create flow: after creation, load() is called but immediate search did not surface the new user until a later full re-login/reload. Clipboard uses navigator.clipboard.writeText without fallback/permission handling. The parent ManagementShell blocks non-admins before UserManager can render its 'Accès restreint' state. Backend email fallback uses setdefault on keys already present as None.
